images.caption: Figure 1: Overview of the SELF-INDEX framework. Given observed queries or queries generated by the Query Simulator, the Optimizer autonomously (1) diagnoses index shortfalls from retrieval outcomes, (2) selectively revises the affected key sets, and (3) validates revisions, updating the index only with accepted changes. As this exploration and optimization loop repeats, the index evolves.
